items.text: Ethereum fell 15.4% over the past week, a big move for it. Indian niches that have moved with Ethereum: Integrated Steel, MNC Subsidiaries and Large HPC Brands.
The NIFTY 500 rose 0.9% on 11 Nov. Capital Goods was the strongest sector (+1.6%) and Media Entertainment & Publication the weakest (+0.3%).
Foreign investors bought a net ₹13,113 Cr of Indian shares in 16-31 Oct 2026, after selling ₹47,956 Cr in 1-15 Oct 2026. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 46 niches.
